Agent._comment: Keep this section the same as in PricingTool.Web and PricingTool.AgentTools (a test compares them). Claude Code headless through the team's subscription; no API key. Enabled is the kill switch.

Limits._comment: Confirmed by the user on 2026-10-30 (config only; the commercial owner may still adjust before go-live): hard minimum floors just under today's lowest hand-set floors (Gj50 5%, Mall 6%); two mid-sized holdout categories per layer as the control group.

Publisher._comment: Hackathon: Sandbox only (shop_sandbox_* in the tool DB), as in PricingTool.AgentTools and Web. Going live is config, see GO-LIVE.md.

CostWatcher._comment: Every 15 minutes: poll the replica's ProductPricing refresh time (about 0.1 s), read costs only after a refresh. Assumed thresholds, to confirm.

PricingEngine._comment: The engine's own retention stays off (its 3-day window would delete the loaded prod runs); the daily cycle's retention step keeps the latest two local runs per layer instead.
